description: Snow day predictor — Will school be closed or delayed for snow, ice or extreme cold? For each of the next 1-3 school mornings: overnight (6 PM-8 AM) snow and ice, school-day snow, morning wind chill and gusts from the NWS forecast grid, plus active winter alerts (Blizzard, Ice Storm, Winter Storm, Wind Chill...) → chancePct 0-99 and verdict SCHOOL AS USUAL / SLIGHT CHANCE / POSSIBLE DELAY OR CLOSURE / CLOSURE LIKELY / CLOSURE VERY LIKELY, with drivers. US only. Params: place= (US city/address) or lat= & lon=; optional days= 1-3 (default 2), region= south|central|north (default from latitude; southern districts close on less snow). Heuristic, not a district announcement. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_snow_day
